name: Medicine shortages
value: UK SSPs in force; no widespread rationing
summary: UK Serious Shortage Protocols cover lansoprazole, Estradot and Creon into January; no new protocol in November
state: NHSBSA lists active Serious Shortage Protocols for lansoprazole orodispersible tablets from 9 Sep to 15 Jan 2027, and for Estradot patches and Creon 25000 capsules to 8 Jan 2027 after amendments on 2 Oct. No new protocol has been issued since 9 Sep. Searches to 11 Nov found no widespread rationing or cancelled treatment across major health systems, so the level stays Watch.
for_you: Patients on lansoprazole orodispersible tablets, Estradot HRT patches or Creon may be given an alternative or a shorter supply by their pharmacist. NHS guidance is to speak to a pharmacist or GP before stopping any medicine.
rubric_hit: UK Serious Shortage Protocols in force for widely used medicines (lansoprazole, Estradot, Creon) meet Watch; no widespread rationing
basis_detail: FDA, EMA and NHSBSA shortage lists
basis_by: FDA, EMA and NHSBSA shortage lists
why: Shipping disruption, factory failures and export curbs can leave essential medicines short, as with US IV fluids after Hurricane Helene in 2024.
drivers: Manufacturing concentrated in India and China, shipping, raw materials, demand spikes, regulation.

rubric.alert: Shortages forcing widespread rationing or cancelled treatment across major health systems.
rubric.watch: A shortage of an essential medicine or supply across several countries, or a UK Serious Shortage Protocol for a widely used medicine.
rubric.normal: No widespread shortages of essential medicines in major health systems.
